math.name: netfold
math.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit image 1, the actual Unity cube unfolding experiment. Image 2 is a real classroom photograph to use as compositing background. Produce ONE polished wide 16:9 AR see-through product illustration for a Chinese science teaching aid presentation. Keep exactly the six connected square faces of the cube net, with mathematically valid adjacency and hinge relationships, preserving the ivory planar face look and relative layout of the experiment. Replace the entire dark virtual room, fake table and opaque black HUD with a real wooden student desk in the photographed classroom. Preserve the real classroom windows, chairs and architecture, brighten to neutral soft daylight rather than heavy orange sunset. Show the six-face net as a gently translucent virtual object hovering 3cm above the real desk with precise thin cyan selection edges; the desk grain and real room remain clearly visible. Close three-quarter view, experiment occupies 60% of frame, enough classroom context visible behind. No people, no hands, no headset border, no UI panels, no words, no numbers, no watermark, no extra scientific objects, no sci-fi room. Do not turn the foreground into solid physical cardboard: it must feel like virtual teaching content viewed through transparent AR glasses. Elegant realistic composite, clean visual hierarchy.

math.name: triangle
math.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit image 1 (actual Unity triangle angles experiment); use image 2 real classroom photograph as supporting background. Create ONE wide 16:9 polished AR classroom teaching aid concept. Preserve the triangle geometry and its three point handles, a golden top movable point and two pale cyan lower endpoints, cyan sides and three subtle interior angle arcs. Remove the opaque black backing board, both black UI panels, all labels and all text. The thin triangular diagram now floats upright above a real classroom desk, with the real desk and classroom seen through its empty interior. Use the photographed classroom architecture, real windows and wooden desks, natural bright neutral daylight and a softly focused background. Triangle is large and central, occupies about 60% of frame. Only three vertices and three edges; no added polygons. Restrained cyan virtual edge light and softly glowing golden top handle, transparent air around them. No black VR environment, no headset or frame, no people, no hands, no fake controls, no writing, no mathematical labels, no watermark. Preserve actual educational object's visual identity and perspective, clearly virtual object within a real classroom.

observation: Use case: compositing. Edit image 1, the actual Unity convex lens experiment; image 2 is a real classroom photograph background reference. Make a beautiful wide 16:9 AR see-through teaching product illustration. Place the existing candle, convex lens and upright image screen in correct order on a real wooden school desk, with the authentic chalkboard classroom visible behind. Keep the relative model arrangement. Light is natural soft daytime, bright enough to see the classroom. Optics demonstration is mostly translucent virtual material, subtle cyan selected edges, a few restrained thin colored rays only (illustrative, no labels), with a clearly upside-down flame image on the screen. Camera from above at three-quarter angle so changes in object position can be understood. No artificial black virtual room, no thick virtual table, no black control panels, no people, no hand, no headset frame, no text, no numbers, no watermark. Experiment fills 60% of frame. Coherent photoreal classroom with virtual apparatus overlay, not a physical equipment catalog shot.
